newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil down, fuel oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil down, fuel oil steady.

text.p: NWE oil products opened mixed on Thursday, gas oil down with futures and fuel oil steady, dealers said.
Public holidays in most of Europe kept trading to a minimum.

Heating oil barges were down $1 a tonne as IPE May gas oil futures fell. Premiums meanwhile were unchanged. Rotterdam running refinery product was offered at May +$1 fob, although few buyers took any interest.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were offered at unchanged levels -- $82 fob Rotterdam. Traders said there was almost no bunker demand.
